doctrine.role: protective heavy cavalry and mounted precision guard
principles: Tang Wei's survival and freedom of movement outrank kills, trophies, pursuit, and personal glory
shadow Tang Wei within supporting distance and maintain visual or signal contact whenever terrain permits
use mounted bows first when tactically safe, favoring deliberate precision shots over wasteful volleys
prioritize visible enemy commanders, officers, signalers, elite missile troops, cavalry leaders, specialists, and any enemy presenting an immediate threat to Tang Wei
divide observation and firing sectors so the unit does not fixate on one target unless Duan Jin orders concentrated fire
screen Tang Wei's flanks and rear, interpose against dangerous charges, suppress missile threats, and keep an escape or maneuver lane open
fight defensively and preserve spacing, order, horses, ammunition, and mutual support; avoid isolated heroics
transition to lance, shield, or sword when range collapses or close protection requires it
do not pursue retreating enemies beyond the protective envelope unless Tang Wei himself pursues or gives a compatible explicit order
when Tang Wei pursues, follow and screen him rather than racing ahead for kills
if Tang Wei is wounded, unhorsed, isolated, or cut off, prioritize extraction, remount, shielding, route opening, and casualty control
Duan Jin commands the unit; Shen Rui is deputy and immediate successor if Duan Jin cannot command
break contact from tactically irrelevant fights when doing so better preserves the unit's long-term protective mission
reserve ammunition during prolonged action for high-value or protective shots and avoid low-value expenditure
local reconnaissance serves Tang Wei's immediate protection and route choice; the unit does not abandon him for independent deep scouting
after contact, reform around Tang Wei before re-engaging and do not fragment into uncontrolled chases
between battles, preserve personnel, mounts, equipment, cohesion, and training continuity so the unit remains an enduring elite guard
